products.name: Kanso Sculptural Oak Armchair
products.subtitle: Hand-carved white oak with textured ivory bouclé
products.description: The Kanso Armchair is crafted from solid American white oak with joinery inspired by traditional Japanese woodwork. Upholstered in dense, stain-resistant Belgian bouclé for a cloud-like tactile seat that ages gracefully.
features: Sustainably harvested solid American White Oak
Belgian heavy bouclé wool blend (80,000 Martindale rubs)
Traditional mortise and tenon joinery with brass dowels
Matte natural hardwax-oil organic finish
products.materials: Solid White Oak, Natural Wool Bouclé, High-resilience Foam

reviews.author: Julian M.
reviews.comment: Even more striking in person. The proportion and tactile warmth of the oak make it the focal point of my studio reading room.

reviews.author: Sophia Chen
reviews.comment: Exceptional build quality. The bouclé cushion provides deep comfort without sagging after months of daily use.

products.name: Acoustic Reference Studio Headphones
products.subtitle: Open-back planar magnetic transducers with brushed alloy
products.description: Engineered for audio mastering engineers, composers, and dedicated audiophiles. Features ultra-thin 50mm planar diaphragms housed within machined anodized aluminum and ventilated microfiber headband pads for fatigue-free listening.
features: 50mm planar magnetic drivers with neodymium N52 motor system
CNC-milled aerospace grade 6061-T6 aluminum chassis
Detachable 4.4mm balanced and 6.35mm gold-plated OFC cables
Sub-0.08% Total Harmonic Distortion at 100dB SPL
products.materials: Anodized Aluminum, Lambskin Memory Foam, Braided Silver-Copper

reviews.author: David Lindqvist
reviews.comment: Unrivaled soundstage separation. Bass is authoritative without bleeding into the midrange, and high frequencies shimmer with zero harshness.

reviews.author: Elena Rostova
reviews.comment: As a mixing engineer, these have become my definitive reference cans. Utterly neutral, honest, and comfortable for 6-hour sessions.

products.name: Moments Eau de Parfum No. 7
products.subtitle: Wild Amber, Smoked Myrrh & Atlas Cedarwood (100ml)
products.description: A contemplative unisex fragrance distilled in small batches in Grasse. Opens with sparkling bergamot and dry juniper berries, evolving into a heart of sacred myrrh and wild resinous amber, anchored by ancient cedar and vetiver.
features: 24% concentrated perfume oil (Extrait de Parfum strength)
Aged for six months in stainless steel barrels prior to bottling
Hand-blown amber UV-resistant glass flacon with solid knurled brass cap
100% cruelty-free, zero phthalates or synthetic preservatives
products.materials: Organic sugarcane alcohol, botanical essences, brass & glass

reviews.author: Marc V.
reviews.comment: Incredible longevity. The warm dry down of smoked myrrh has gotten me countless compliments wherever I go.

products.name: Heavy Selvedge Canvas Studio Tote
products.subtitle: 22oz Kurashiki cotton with bridle leather handles
products.description: Woven on vintage shuttle looms in Okayama, Japan, this utilitarian tote bag is cut from dense 22oz water-repellent paraffin-waxed cotton canvas. Reinforced with solid copper rivets and full-grain vegetable-tanned bridle leather handles.
features: 22oz heavy selvedge canvas with paraffin water-repellent wax treatment
Thick 4mm vegetable-tanned Wickett & Craig saddle leather handles
Hand-hammered solid copper saddlery rivets
Padded internal compartment sized for up to 16-inch laptops
products.materials: 100% Cotton Selvedge Canvas, Full Grain Harness Leather

reviews.author: Hannah K.
reviews.comment: Indestructible. It holds my laptop, sketchbook, coffee thermos, and daily essentials with structure and timeless aesthetic.

products.name: Hagi Stoneware Mineral Vase
products.subtitle: Coarse speckled clay with natural wood-ash glaze
products.description: Wheel-thrown by studio potters using iron-rich mountain clay. Fired in a wood-burning climbing kiln over three days, resulting in unique organic variations in ash melting and earthy textured surface.
features: High-fired mineral stoneware, water-tight internal glazing
Naturally variegated wood ash exterior finish
Each piece is individually wheel-thrown and numbered
products.materials: High-fire stoneware clay, natural wood ash glaze

reviews.author: Koji Sato
reviews.comment: The tactile texture of the raw clay brings peaceful balance to our dining table.

products.name: Minimalist Walnut Bluetooth Amplifier
products.subtitle: Class-D audiophile 100W desktop stereo receiver
products.description: A compact high-fidelity audio receiver engineered with Texas Instruments TPA3255 chipset and LDAC Bluetooth 5.2 lossless streaming. Hand-finished walnut casing with machined brass rotary volume knob.
features: 100W RMS per channel into 4Ω at 0.005% THD+N
Hi-Res Audio certified with aptX HD and LDAC 990kbps codec
Solid CNC carved walnut enclosure with isolated ground plane
products.materials: Solid American Walnut, Brushed Aluminum, Gold Plated Terminals

reviews.author: Bradley Cooper
reviews.comment: Drives my bookshelf speakers with clarity and zero background hiss. The tactile feel of the brass dial is pure joy.
